entities.name: Breeches, Brazen Plunderer
entities.description: A blue-furred goblin pirate and explosives expert of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan, best friend of Malcolm Lee.

entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: A siren pirate and Breeches' best friend, whose hypnotic song helped them escape the mycoids.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate faction on Ixalan to which Breeches and Malcolm belong.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the Brazen Coalition operates.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker thought compleated and dead in the New Phyrexian Invasion; she contacts Breeches and Malcolm for a vault job.

entities.name: Vraska's Belligerent
entities.description: Vraska's ship, on which Breeches served.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The Golden City, pillaged by the pirates of Vraska's Belligerent.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact the pirates failed to steal in Orazca.

entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: Asked Malcolm and Breeches to investigate disappearances in Downtown.

entities.name: Downtown
entities.description: A mining town under Coalition control that was found deserted.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: The entity controlling the mycoids and animated corpses, destroyed by Breeches.

entities.name: mycoids
entities.description: Fungal creatures that animated miners' corpses and creatures.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: Passage through which Malcolm and Breeches lured the mycoids to Ixalan's Core.

entities.name: Ixalan's Core
entities.description: Site of a pitched battle between Huatli's expedition and Vito's vampires.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Leader of an expedition party fighting at Ixalan's Core.

entities.name: Vito
entities.description: Leader of the vampire heretics fighting Huatli's expedition.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: Place where Breeches got his firearm and where the pair returned.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Vraska was believed compleated and dead.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who plotted a vault heist on Thunder Junction, disguised as Ashiok.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane newly connected to the Multiverse via the Omenpaths, with an ancient vault.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Hired by Jace to assemble a band of outlaws to raid the vault.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: An archaeologist kidnapped from a train.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Outlaw who did not follow the train plan.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Slowed the train so passengers could escape and backed up the team.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young creature that was Jace's prize from the vault.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths connecting Thunder Junction to the Multiverse.

events.summary: Ripley Vance sends Malcolm and Breeches to investigate disappearances in Downtown, which they find deserted.
events.quote: Upon arrival, they found the town deserted.

events.summary: In the mines, the party is attacked by mycoid-animated corpses and meets the Mycotyrant.
events.quote: before coming face to face with the entity that controlled them, the Mycotyrant

events.summary: Breeches destroys the Mycotyrant with a powerful firearm, collapsing the mycoids.
events.quote: Breeches destroyed the Mycotyrant with a powerful firearm

events.summary: Vraska, thought dead, contacts Breeches and Malcolm; they are overjoyed and agree to help her and Jace with a vault plot.
events.quote: They were overjoyed to see her alive.

events.summary: Breeches joins the outlaw band as explosives expert and to secretly support Vraska.
events.quote: Breeches joined the team as an explosives expert

events.summary: The gang plans to kidnap Nolan by blowing a bridge; Gisa deviates and the train nearly goes over before Kellan slows it.
events.quote: Kellan was able to slow the train enough for its passengers to escape before it was destroyed.

events.summary: Oko opens the vault for Jace and Vraska; Jace takes Loot and triggers a collapse, but the team escapes, after which Breeches and Malcolm leave the plane.
events.quote: Breeches and Malcolm left the plane.
